Ava (Head of Product): quick follow-up from today's all-hands on packaging + usage policy. drop short clarifying Qs here and we'll capture answers for the public FAQ.

Mike (Billing PM): to start: are rate limits enforced before credits are checked? customer had a race when topping up.

Riley (SRE): enforcement order is: auth -> rate-limit check -> quota/credit check -> accept. so a request can be 429ed before seeing a newly applied top-up that hasn't propagated. propagation usually <60s.

Kai (Solutions Eng): can customers set different quotas per API key? some teams want shared account credits but isolated dev keys.

Mike (Billing PM): hosted accounts can attach per-key quotas via Console. Dedicated/Private supports namespaced quotas via the YAML policy config. we'll add an example to docs.

Jules (Finance): how do refunds work if a big spike consumed credits during a misconfiguration?

Mike (Billing PM): refunds are handled case-by-case. standard policy: investigate, if it's a platform fault we credit back; if user misconfig, we offer one-time exception credits for first-time incidents. escalations go to finance@.

Kai (Solutions Eng): what's the difference between "reserved credits" and regular monthly credits in the console UI?

Ava (Head of Product): reserved = committed/contracted balance tied to a reserved capacity plan. monthly credits are the soft pool for hosted usage. reserved credits are applied first for billing and can have rollover depending on contract.

Riley (SRE): question about 429 behavior: do retries increment usage if the original was rejected?

Mike (Billing PM): if rejected with 429 at rate-limit stage then no tokens/units are consumed. If request is accepted and then fails during generation, partial tokens may be billed depending on where generation aborted. we'll document approximate semantics.

Kai (Solutions Eng): customers ask for temporary burst for product launches. is there a self-serve flow?

Mike (Billing PM): yes for hosted: Console -> Usage -> Increase burst (temporary). it requires a payment method on file for overage charges. For Dedicated/Private, open a ticket with CS and we can issue a scoped temporary increase.

Jules (Finance): what visibility do customers get into predicted monthly spend if they enable aggressive batching/quantization?

Ava (Head of Product): Console shows modeled spend based on current config and last 7/30 day traffic. Optimize suggestions will show estimated cost delta when toggling batching/quant profiles. it's in beta but rolling out next week.

Kai (Solutions Eng): small request: can we publish an SLA-friendly blurb about what happens when a customer's credits expire mid-job? customers worried about long-running jobs being killed.

Riley (SRE): current behavior: short-running API calls are allowed to finish if accepted. background jobs that poll will get blocked once credits are exhausted unless the route is marked priority-exempt. we'll add clear wording and examples.

Mike (Billing PM): action items: 1) I'll draft a "credits vs limits" FAQ and the refund escalation flow, aim EOW. 2) Kai will collect common customer asks about burst windows. 3) Riley will add the 429/propagation note to rate-limit doc.

Ava (Head of Product): thanks all. please add any follow-ups here. we'll fold into the public FAQ and ping marketing for an announcement. Closing thread in 24h. :white_check_mark:
